titulo: Mundo: Empleo en industria, por países
subtitulo: % del empleo total · último dato disponible
fuente: Fuente: Organización Internacional del Trabajo. Elaboración: Centro de Estudios POPULI · Carlos Aranda.
nota: Employment is defined as persons of working age who were engaged in any activity to produce goods or provide services for pay or profit, whether at work during the reference period or not at work due to temporary absence from a job.
